Game Overview

Matching Fruits is a memory title where race against time in this vibrant memory challenge. Flip fruit-themed cards to uncover matching pairs in a 4x4 grid. With smooth animations and a moves tracker, each turn is a test of recall and strategy. Will you master the shuffle and flip your way to victory?
